instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Put a person's name on what they said in a listening before I enrolled their voice", and give it listening (The listening's name); voices (The labels the voice was heard under: the enrol tool's heard_as, or one voice-N); name (The enrolled person's name).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:name-a-heard-voice and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: After tool:enrol-a-voice-or-face names a voice heard in a listening (its heard_as), renames that listening's heard turns still under "Someone (voice-N)" for those voices to the person's name, keeping the former label on each row.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: heard (records:list, records:write).
